nc14e13.title: Pisces cries at the first snow
nc14e13.caption: Pisces cried at a snowflake, then a snowman, then deleted a two-word text. The snow got a reply before Pisces did. What's the text you keep typing and never sending?

nc14e14.title: The double date
nc14e14.caption: One couple skates in perfect sync with matching mugs. The other apologised three times in ten seconds. Fun fact: the smooth ones started with someone in a fountain. Which pair is your group chat?

nc14e15.title: Are we cuffed or just cold?
nc14e15.caption: Sag and Aquarius added a scarf, a second blanket and a third, all for science. One honest question did what three blankets couldn't. Are you cuffed or just cold?

nc14e16.title: The matching mittens
nc14e16.caption: Capricorn rehearsed a gift speech on a snowman until its nose fell off. The real speech was one line long, and Cancer had knitted a scarf anyway. Tag the friend who over-rehearses.

nc14e17.title: Who texts first when it's freezing
nc14e17.caption: Scorpio thinks texting first means losing. Taurus thinks it means too much. Two hours of drafts later they sent the same text in the same second. Who usually breaks first, you or them?

nc14e18.title: The ex shows up with cocoa
nc14e18.caption: The ex brought cocoa and the snow-day memories. Libra said thank you, said no, and still sounded kind. Gemini left with both mugs, which seems fair. What's your kindest no?

nc14e19.title: The friend who's single and fine
nc14e19.caption: The friends showed up with a mystery card, a someone, and a lot of pity. Virgo showed up with soup, a puzzle and a full life. Soup night won. Who's the Virgo of your friend group?

nc14e20.title: The cozy-night-in debate
nc14e20.caption: Aries pitched sledding, string lights and a snowball, then took the snowball to the face. Pisces pitched soup and a sad-dog movie. Turns out one night fits both. Night in or night out?

nc14e21.title: Defining it before the holidays
nc14e21.caption: Scorpio rehearsed three openers for the talk, including a slideshow. One talk card and one question did the whole job before the holiday dinner. Did you have the talk early or wing it at dinner?

nc14e22.title: Taking it slow on purpose
nc14e22.caption: Everyone else zoomed past on sleds. Virgo and Gemini stopped for a snowflake, a dog and a bench, and still made plans for next week. Slow walkers, where are you?

nc14e23.title: The one who was never seasonal
nc14e23.caption: Everyone else got cuffed when it got cold. Scorpio has been bringing Taurus flowers, shade and leaf piles since spring. Some crushes don't check the weather. Who's your every-weather person?

nc14e24.title: Finale: Not cuffed. Chosen.
nc14e24.caption: Twelve signs, one very cold month, and every pair still standing under the lights. They swapped the blankets for talk cards, and nobody let go when the snow stopped. Which couple did you root for?
